items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Dorsey -- of course I knew him, he used to come around. He's a fun guy.

ctx.x: But in those days if you were a saxophone player you had to play with some kind of tone. You had to have some beauty in your playing, like they say, and if you didn't have it, then you were kaput. Like I remember in Chick Webb's band we had the three saxophone players, Elmer Williams, Hilton Jefferson and myself, and we used to alternate on the playing the lead, you know, because Jeff had a better tone than I did. See, he could play something real pretty and beautiful. So he played the first part, you know. But…

the time I was in Chicago with Kirby, Jimmy Dorsey -- of course I knew him, he used to come around. He's a fun guy. He's a happy guy. He used to come around, and he wrote a magazine article. I don't think that magazine is still existing. He wrote a magazine article and he picked the 12 best alto players, and he picked me as one of them, which I thought was a terrific thing, you know, and I meant to keep that magazine, but I've long since lost it. I don't know what happened to it. And it had all our pictures, of…
